settings.heading: Why the Methods Are So Effective
settings.text:
These weight loss programs are designed to reset your relationship with food, helping you reach your overall health goals in a sustainable and maintainable way.

Each Method varies slightly, but the basic concept is the same:

#1 You’ll start each morning with a cold-pressed juice that helps detox your body and eliminates unhealthy cravings—this sets the rest of your day up for success. You’ll also be able to eat plenty of fruit and other foods suggested in the program guidelines.


#2 For lunch you’ll have a nutrient-dense meal that’s rich in carbohydrates, healthy fats, plant-based protein, and fiber to keep you full longer.

#3 You’ll receive clear and simple clean-eating guidelines that teach you how to eat from “light to heavy” each day and properly combine your foods. This is the key to eliminate bloating and have long-term weight loss success.

settings.heading: Health Benefits
settings.text:
Lose weight without dieting or deprivation.

  • The Skinny Method™ was designed to break the diet cycle for good. 
  • Instead of counting calories or restricting carbs, this plan teaches you how to fuel your body with real, nutrient-dense foods that support natural weight loss. No need to worry about portion control or weighing food here - this is reset without restriction.
  • The key to this program is learning how to structure your day of eating from “light to heavy”. Once this is mastered, bloating disappears and weight naturally falls off at a slow, yet consistent pace that you can maintain for the long-term.

Feel energized, satisfied, and in control of your eating habits.

  • Crashes and cravings happen when your body doesn’t get the nutrients it needs. 
  • The Skinny Method™ focuses on nourishment, not restriction—so you feel full and energized and satiated all day long. 
  • You get natural energy and daily detox from green juices each morning. Every lunch smoothie is designed to balance blood sugar and keep hunger hormones in check. The digestive power of the Skinny Boost™ pre-dinner shots help to eliminate uncomfortable bloating. And the clean dinner you eat every night covers all the bases of carbs, protein, and healthy fats.

Eliminate unhealthy cravings to avoid weight gain.

  • Cravings are often your body’s way of signaling a lack of nutrition—or a blood sugar imbalance. 
  • The Skinny Method™ helps reset your taste buds and combat those cravings with real food. 
  • Your daily green juice is packed with chlorophyll, minerals, and enzymes that stop sugar cravings and help your body be fully nourished.

Support your gut health and more regular digestion.

  • Gut health is the foundation of nearly everything. It impacts your weight, energy, skin, and even your mood. 
  • The Skinny Method™ includes a green juice every morning that is rich in chlorophyll.  Chlorophyll resets your gut homeostasis over time so that your body is able to better absorb nutrients.
  • The Skinny Method™ also supports a healthy gut with a daily shot designed to eliminate bloating and improve digestion. 
  • This program encourages lots of high fiber and water-rich foods - these help to reduce inflammation and keep things moving, thus improving elimination and supporting a healthier gut environment.

Build healthy eating habits that actually last.

  • The Skinny Method™ isn’t a cleanse—it’s a lifestyle system you can repeat week after week. 
  • You’ll learn how to structure your meals, reset your relationship with food, and incorporate real nutrition into your everyday routine. Everything is provided in a format that is easy for even the busiest person to be able to adopt and maintain.
  • This program builds in the reality of social events and eating out. With tips and guides on how to eat out in a restaurant or bar and the suggestion of an 80/20 mentality when it comes to eating, you are able to navigate any social setting without falling off the wagon with your health or weight loss goals.

settings.heading: A Typical Day on a Method
settings.text:
You’ll receive 6 juices and/or smoothies for each day of your juice cleanse. We recommend drinking your first bottle no later than 8am and drinking one bottle at least every 2 hours, finishing the last juice around 6pm. 

Wake up & drink a large glass of water, have your coffee, and some fresh fruit.

8am - Bottle #1  

10am- Bottle #2

12 noon- Bottle #3

2pm- Bottle #4

4pm- Bottle #5

6pm- Bottle #6

The order in which you drink all 6 flavors does not matter - you will get all of the benefits regardless of the order in which you drink them.

We find that if you wait too long between juices, you can run the risk of becoming too hungry. So the timing is more important than the order. However, each product page

We recommend eating as much fresh fruit and vegetables as you desire throughout each day- either with your juices or in between. This includes baked, roasted, or steamed potatoes.

Your Cleanse Guide will include the whole list of cleanse approved foods and a recipe for a hearty vegetable soup that you can eat at any point during your cleanse.

We recommend that you drink your coffee either black or with a low fat plant-milk like oatmilk. Adding sugar and creamer will defeat the purpose of doing a juice cleanse. 

Drinking water throughout the day is recommended.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.text:
Is this product a cleanse?
No. The Skinny Method™ is a weight management program, not a juice cleanse. It's a daily healthy eating system that helps you reach your weight loss goals by combining ready-made drinks with whole food nutrition in an easy-to-follow format.

Can I cleanse before I use this product?
Yes! If you're looking for a deeper reset and maximum weight loss results, we recommend starting with the Skinny Cleanse before transitioning to The Skinny Method™. This can help cleanse your tastebuds and jumpstart your new healthier eating habits. For more info on the Skinny Cleanse, click here.

Can I eat on this program?
Absolutely, you can and should eat with this program. You’ll receive easy-to-follow healthy lifestyle tips from our in-house nutritionist and guidance for meals and snacks. You’ll learn how to eat in a way that supports weight loss, energy, and well-being.

Can I exercise on this plan?
Yes, we recommend regular physical activity and maintaining your normal workouts while using The Skinny Method™. The juices and smoothies provide lean protein, healthy fats, and carbohydrates to support recovery and fuel your body.

What are the Nutritionist’s Clean Eating Guidelines?

As part of this weight loss journey, you’ll receive a full lifestyle guide with over 38 recipes and tips—just like you'd get from an in-person consultation with our nutritionist.

You’ll likely need to unlearn a lot of the incorrect advice you’ve followed from previous diet programs about fruit sugar and carbohydrates causing weight gain. Once you can overcome those mental stumbling blocks, you’ll unlock weight loss and health benefits like you’ve never had before.

Here are a few core principles:

  • Don’t cook in oils or fats. Instead, roast on parchment, steam, or air-fry.
  • Enjoy carbohydrates. Multiple servings of fruits, potatoes, and whole grains are encouraged daily for energy and metabolism.
  • Avoid processed "healthy" foods like bars and cereals with fillers.
  • Limit dairy to organic butter or pastured eggs (and skip dairy at breakfast).
  • Focus on balance: A proper plate = 50% veggies, 25% carbs, 25% lean protein or plant-based equivalent.
